exposure: dietary inflammatory potential [measured via the energy-adjusted dietary inflammatory index (E-DII™)]
circulating cytokines (IL-12, IL-17, IL-4, IL-6, and TNFα)
offspring methylation at the MEG3 regulatory sequence
finding: A pro-inflammatory diet during pregnancy was associated with elevated rates of preterm birth among female offspring and higher rates of caesarean delivery among obese women.
mod_finding: Pro-inflammatory diets were associated with higher rates of caesarean delivery among obese women.
